title: Japan national CPI (September 2026) — the last national print the BoJ's October Outlook Report sees, and an already-registered forward test's missing input
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release'), fetched direct 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single 17-row HTML table during the never-assessed initial research of japan-cpi-2026-09-18. On the same column pairing that reproduces japan-cpi-2026-11-20.json's independent parse, the row reads exactly ['September', 'October 23', 'October', 'October 30', ''] — the September-2026 NATIONAL CPI releases 2026-10-23 (a Friday), empty Remarks cell, so no yearly or fiscal-yearly average rides with it. Filed estimate on this lane's no-self-confirm limit, because the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, and because the schedule page's own stamp is still 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'. Release time is not read off this page and is not asserted.
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-15 during the never-assessed initial research of japan-cpi-2026-09-18 and owned by that lane (docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md, one file per owner, #1717). Filed against a standing precedent rather than in ignorance of it: japan-cpi-2026-11-20.json deliberately did NOT file this date, on the stated ground that it 'would spend its own never-assessed session to learn nothing'. The reason that changed is concrete and measurable. FIRST, the same PR that declined it registered FT-japan-cpi-2026-11-20-1, whose kill switch reads 'the average of the 2026-10-23 national September core y/y and the 2026-10-30 Tokyo October core y/y missing the 2026-11-20 national October core print by more than 0.2pp' — so a live, pre-registered forward test consumes this print as an input while nothing on the calendar tracks it, and the session that scores it would have to rediscover the date. SECOND, by that sibling's own measured structure, the BoJ's Outlook-Report meetings convene 3-6 days after a national print against 24-27 days for non-Outlook ones; the October MPM is 'Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)' with an Outlook Report, so this release is the last whole-country observation that Outlook is written with — 6 days out — and the 2026-10-30 decision is also FT-boj-decision-2026-09-18-2's scoring venue. Impact stays LOW on the same grounds every Japanese entry here carries: symbols is empty and no house playbook is keyed to Japanese prices. Deliberately NOT proposed alongside it, and named here so the non-file is on the record rather than an omission: the Tokyo October flash (2026-10-30, same table row), which is the other input to FT-japan-cpi-2026-11-20-1 but shares its date with the already-tracked boj-decision-2026-10-30, so the corridor surfaces it for free.
